text:
Alex: hey team, i'm taking primary for the next 8h starting now :wave: quick handoff — please confirm access for escalation and dashboards before we get into any incidents. thread for perms/coverage only.

OpsBot: Reminder: on-call handoff detected. Please verify PagerDuty, AWS console, and Grafana access within 15m. Use `@OpsBot confirm` when done. (automated)

Sam: Alex — i don't see myself on the pager schedule for nights, only weekday days. i tried PD but get 'not authorized' when trying to escalate. can someone confirm i have the right role and schedule membership? :eyes:

Alex: Sam — weird. you should be on the "infra-oncall" rotation. i can add you if needed. quick checks:
- PagerDuty: are you in Okta group `pd-infra-rotations`?
- AWS: do you have `redwood-infra-MFA` role allowed?
- Grafana: read access to `prod-*` dashboards is required (admin only for runbook edits)

Priya: adding runbook links — follow these during handoff and incident start:
- Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/infra-handoff
- PagerDuty guide: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pagerduty-escalation
- Grafana dashboards list: https://grafana.redwood.internal/dashboards/list

Sam: thanks — Okta shows i'm in `engineers` but not `pd-infra-rotations`. i can't add myself. alex, can you add me or ping infra-ops? also i get MFA prompt on aws and then `AccessDenied` when running `aws sts assume-role`.

Mike: Sam, i'll give you temporary PD escalation access. i'll create a temporary role mapping in Okta and add you to the PD schedule. Doing it now — will post proof once done. Also granting a short-lived Grafana editor token if you need to pin runbook panels.

Mike: (after) Added Sam to `pd-infra-rotations` and started a 24h membership. PD CLI command used:
```
pd users add --email sam@redwood.com --role responder --schedule infra-oncall
```
Also created a Grafana API key scoped `Viewer+DashEdit` valid for 12h and DM'ed it to Sam (:lock:)

Sam: got the PD email invite and can see the schedule now — can escalate. Grafana token received, dashboards load. AWS still failing: `aws sts assume-role` returns `AccessDenied`. i think the role ARN is `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall`

Alex: AWS note — oncall VPC/account needs `ReadOnlyAccess` + `CloudWatchLogsReadOnly` to view logs and metrics. to assume the oncall role run:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name oncall-session
```
If you still get denied, check Okta entitlements and the `redwood-oncall` trust policy. mike / infra team need to update the role trust if Okta groups changed.

Priya: also FYI — incident-bot commands for declaring incidents and setting severity:
- `/incident declare Sev2 "description"` to create incident and page primary
- `/incident annotate <id> <note>` to attach notes
IncidentBot: Use `/incident handoff @username` to reassign primary. :information_source:

Sam: i retried after logging out/in to Okta and it worked — assumed role successfully. verified CloudWatch logs and Grafana panels. all good from my side.

Alex: great. coverage gaps: nights on Sat/Sun are thin if someone is OOO. please mark your OOO in the schedule. i'll follow up later with infra to automate PD group sync with Okta to avoid manual adds.

Mike: filed infra ticket INF-4823 to fix trust relationship and automate Okta->PD mapping. ETA 48h. link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INF-4823

Alex: actions:
- Mike: finalize INF-4823 (48h)
- Mike: confirm Grafana token audit and rotate after 12h (done)
- Priya: update runbook with explicit Okta check step (i'll update now)
- Sam: confirm you can escalate during your shift (ack by EOD)

Sam: ack, i'll monitor and post if anything pops up. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Handoff complete. Primary: Alex. Secondary: Sam. Handoff notes saved to log. (automated)
